$comment: The shared runner identity manifest of the release evidence gate (docs/ci-evidence.md#runner-identity).
Vendor it unchanged, as .github/runner-identity.json, and pin its SHA-256 in .github/ci-evidence.json
(identity.sha256); the gate takes only a revision it ships. A change is a new kit revision, never a local edit.
It describes a REPORTED image identity, not a pinned VM image: a standard GitHub-hosted runner is chosen by a
label that GitHub moves to newer images, and the gate can only compare what each runner reports about itself.
runner: the fields each job records and the gate compares, per variant and profile. ImageOS and ImageVersion
are the image name and version the runner reports; os_release is the SHA-256 of the variant's OS-release file
(null: the OS has none, and the field is not recorded). actions: every action and reusable workflow a
workflow names is a local path, a full commit id or an image digest; a tag or a branch refuses.

windows-x64.$comment: Windows has no OS-release file; its identity is the reported image name and version, the platform and the tools.
